Class RealizedGainReport

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reports.RealizedGainReport
@Component public class RealizedGainReport extends Object
Report of the capital gains a tenant realized by selling securities, grouped by calendar year and in the main currency. It is a neutral report that works for every country: it states what the transaction calculation of the selected cost basis method realized and calculates no tax.

It runs separately from SecurityDividendsReport, which knows no cost and feeds the tax statement eCH-0196 and the income charts. The calculation itself is RealizedGainCalculator, this class only loads what it needs.

Important: This class is a stateless Spring component and holds no member variables besides its collaborators.

    • getRealizedGainGrandTotalByTenant

      public RealizedGainGrandTotal getRealizedGainGrandTotalByTenant(Integer idTenant, List<Integer> idsSecurityaccount, CostBasisMethod costBasisMethod)
      Calculates the realized gains of a tenant.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the tenant whose sales are reported
      idsSecurityaccount - the security accounts whose sales are listed, empty or -1 for all. The filter does not change the gain of a sale. An id of another tenant matches no sale.
      costBasisMethod - the method for all security accounts, or null for the method of each security account as tenant and portfolios have set it
      Returns:
      the years with their sales and the sums over all years
